note: Cross-repo contract for the tmpx_ managed-model token. The Cloud MINTS (infraweaver-ui src/features/billing/proxy.ts) and the EU gateway VERIFIES (infraweaver-proxy src/token.ts); the two share no code, so a byte-for-byte fixture is the only thing that pins them. The secret is a fixture value, never a real key. Committed in BOTH repos; each side reads its own copy and byte-compares the sibling's when checked out.
